items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All ACs implemented: review_scratch.py resolver (no sweep), 4 diff-boundary files independently resolve+cleanup, campaign-mode.md switched to a direct stdin pipe, guard test added, docs/guide.md updated.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: resolve()/cleanup() raise ReviewScratchError on unsafe run_id/name before any filesystem op; cmd_init checks the units file exists (file mode) or reads stdin (pipe mode); JSON parse errors propagate unchanged from the pre-existing behavior, not a new gap.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No SQL/HTML surface. No hardcoded secrets. run_id/name validated by strict regex; cleanup rejects symlinks/reparse points and checks parent-containment before rmtree; private root reuses host_resource_lease.py's hardened ACL/permission primitives.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Tests assert on outcomes (resolved paths, file content, raised exceptions, subprocess exit codes and stdout/state JSON), not internals. Each has a distinct happy-path or rejection case.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No DB/query surface, no unbounded lists; stdin read replaces one file read, same cost class.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New files follow the lib/tools/tests convention and are all under 300 lines (review_scratch.py 85, tools/review_scratch.py 58). Edited bloat-baselined files stayed within their existing exception ceilings: autonomous_loop.py 436/436 (grandfathered), sub-iterate-runner.md 497/497 (ADR-119).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer/consumer pairs listed in the iterate spec's Affected Boundaries table; round-trip tests exist for all three (diff-file resolve/cleanup, campaign_units.json stdin pipe, resolve-path stdout-to-bash-substitution).
